jobs.title: Senior Tech Product Owner
jobs.description:
NICE TO MEET YOU!

IN SHORT
 At FELFEL, we’re redefining how people eat at work by bringing fresh and healthy food directly into companies across Switzerland. As our Senior Tech Product Owner (80-100%) based in Zürich Wiedikon, you will lead our Operations Value Stream and own the systems behind our daily operations. FELFEL operates a diverse ecosystem of digital products, including our customer website and application, fridges and coffee machines POS systems, and internal tools that support our teams. You will shape and build FELFEL’s digital products, improving the experience for customers, partners, and internal users alike.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own the digital product strategy and roadmap for our Operations domain, prioritizing initiatives based on business impact, technical feasibility, and user needs.

• Lead the discovery and development of initiatives in close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders, guiding the process from problem definition to actionable solutions.

• Translate complex operational challenges into scalable, user-centric solutions to create products that are efficient and intuitive in day-to-day operations.

• Improve your products continuously through data-driven decision-making, experimentation, and feedback loops to ensure measurable impact.

• Ensure smooth system integrations across our diverse ecosystem, contributing to a reliable and scalable operations landscape.

• Plan and execute end-to-end testing to guarantee product quality and reliability.

• Communicate clearly and effectively with stakeholders, maintaining transparency, alignment, and well-managed expectations throughout the product lifecycle.

WHAT TO EXPECT

YOUR PROFILE

• Multiple years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager building digital products.

• Strong data affinity and the capacity to use data to drive product decisions.

• Familiarity with agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban.

• Proficiency with common AI and LLM tools, along with a solid understanding of effective prompting.

• Background in food, supply chain, or ERP systems serves as a strong plus.

• Capability to break down complex problems into actionable steps that drive product development.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, paired with a structured way of thinking.

• User-centric mindset with proven experience in mapping user journeys and creating low-fidelity prototypes.

• Hands-on mentality with the resilience to stay pragmatic and solution-oriented, even in busy or fast-paced situations.

• Excellent communication skills in English; German is a plus.

• Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

• Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

YOU WILL BE MEASURED BY

OUR BENEFITS

• Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true

• Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine

• 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation

• Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day

• We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund

• New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.

• We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard

• Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing

• Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions

Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either German or English.

APPLY NOW

ABOUT US
 FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality.
With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;).
FELFEL is a family business that was founded in 2013. Today, we take care of around 1000 locations in Switzerland, and have 150 employees across our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York.
www.felfel.ch

FELFEL VALUES

jobs.description:
NICE TO MEET YOU!

IN SHORT

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
 As part of our picking team, prepare customer orders by packing products into crates, organizing them on pallets, and getting everything ready for pickup by our logistics partner. The picking process takes place in our CoolCell, at a temperature of 2–5°C. On average, shifts last around 5 hours (sometimes shorter or longer, depending on workload). Shifts run Sunday through Friday, with two teams (sometimes shorter or longer, depending on workload).

Shift Model: Initially, you will be scheduled for shifts within the following windows: Weekdays (12:00–22:00) and Sundays (09:00–22:00).

• Mon – Fri Early: Starts at 12:00 (approx. 5h)

• Mon – Fri Late: Starts at 14:00 (approx. 7h)

• Sunday Early: Starts at 09:00 (approx. 7h)

• Sunday Late: Starts at 13:00 (approx. 7h)
 Note: After the initial training period, you may become eligible for morning shifts (starting between 07:00 and 09:00).

WHAT TO EXPECT

YOUR PROFILE

• You are fluent in English.

• You value speed, reliability, and pay close attention to detail.

• Working in winter temperatures (2–5°C) while wearing warm gear (gloves/hat) is no problem for you.

• You can commit to at least:
• 2 full weekdays per week (flexible regarding early/late shift).

• 2 full Sundays per month (flexible regarding early/late shift).

• Logistics or warehouse experience (picking, packing, pallet handling) is a plus, but not required.

• You are a non-smoker. At FELFEL, we value healthy living and high hygiene standards; therefore, you do not smoke during the day and never smell of smoke.

• You hold a valid EU/EFTA passport or a Swiss work permit.

YOU WILL BE MEASURED BY

OUR BENEFITS

• CHF 25.00/hour (gross)

• Regular shifts

• A (truly!) friendly and international team

If this sounds like the job for you, then APPLY NOW, we are looking forward to hearing from you!

jobs.description:
NICE TO MEET YOU!

IN SHORT
 Do you speak multiple languages, have a knack for logistics, and always keep track of everything? Join FELFEL’s dispatcher team as an Operations Coordinator (hourly contract, 50-60%) in either Zurich Wiedikon or Lausanne Flon and help us elevate our operational excellence!

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Ensure high-quality service and a smooth operational experience by consistently monitoring our service standards to keep customer satisfaction as a top priority.

• Communicate effectively with our third-party logistics partners and multilingual drivers across various channels, acting quickly while maintaining a clear overview.

• Act as a key point of contact for operational supply chain processes, driving efficient organization, oversight, and proactive issue resolution.

• Coordinate closely with our customer service and hardware teams to resolve any challenges quickly and efficiently.

WHAT TO EXPECT

YOUR PROFILE

• Practical experience in an operational, logistics, or coordination role is a strong advantage.

• Excellent communication and coordination skills to engage effectively with a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders as a dedicated team player.

• Exceptional eye for detail combined with a natural talent for multitasking and seamless organization.

• Solution-oriented mindset and high motivation, maintaining focus and drive even when navigating complex challenges.

• Fluency in English is required. For the Zurich office, fluency in German is essential, while for the Lausanne office, fluency in French is necessary (speaking all three is a fantastic bonus!).

• Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

• Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

YOU WILL BE MEASURED BY

OUR BENEFITS

• Hourly rate of CHF 25.00 with regular working shifts.

• Enjoy fresh, high-quality meals just steps away from your workspace, every day.

• Fuel your day with barista-style coffee and premium tea, thanks to our Gavetti machine.

• Work in a collaborative environment that values initiative and gives you the space to contribute your ideas.

jobs.title: IoT Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
NICE TO MEET YOU!

IN SHORT
 Are you ready to build the backbone of our smart workplace technology? As our new IoT Platform Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will own the transition of our hardware fleet into a highly reliable, streamlined system. FELFEL puts smart fridges and coffee machines in offices across Switzerland and the US, and every line of code you write will run in a real workplace, serving real people every day.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own the device runtime on our fridges and coffee machine controllers (Gavettis) end to end, managing everything from zero-touch provisioning, device bootstrap, call-home and on-device applications.

• Drive the consolidation of our fleet management onto a single platform, making the architectural choices and defending them.

• Reduce the number of programming languages running on the edge, bringing our cloud and device environments closer together.

• Partner with the Head of Engineering to spec the next generation of fridge and Gavetti hardware, pick vendors, and define the software contracts.

• Manage and evolve vendor relationships and integrations for our vendors and badge reader suppliers.

• Act as the ultimate reality check on the engineering team for what is actually running and succeeding in the field.

WHAT TO EXPECT

YOUR PROFILE

• 5+ years of experience building production systems, with a proven track record of shipping and operating a real fleet of devices in production (handling real users, outages, and OTA updates).

• Strong working knowledge of edge platform concerns, including networking (VPNs, NAT, flaky links), Linux and Android on small hardware, OS-level debugging, and observability for offline-tolerant systems.

• Comfort and proficiency across at least two of the following languages: C#, Go, or Kotlin, with a willingness to standardize.

• Deep understanding of hardware as an interface, with the ability to navigate Modbus, USB, serial connections, sensor datasheets, and vendor SDKs.

• Experience with Balena, Azure IoT Hub, KubeEdge, Kubernetes, Docker, or containerized workloads is a strong plus.

• Familiarity with commercial appliance ecosystems (like coffee machines or vending) and enough electronics literacy to read a datasheet and ask the right questions.

• Pragmatic problem-solving mindset—you would rather standardize than invent, and you choose the boring, reliable tool over the purely interesting one.

• Fluency in English, German is nice to have

• Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

• Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

YOU WILL BE MEASURED BY

OUR BENEFITS

• Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true

• Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine

• 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation

• Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day

• We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund

• New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.

• We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard

• Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing

• Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions

Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either German or English.

APPLY NOW

ABOUT US

FELFEL VALUES

jobs.title: Customer Service Manager (60%)
jobs.description:
## IN KÜRZE

Als unsere neue/ unser neuer Customer Service Manager (60%) in Zürich steht für dich die Kundenzufriedenheit im Zentrum unserer Werte. Du bist die wichtigste Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass sie sich bei jeder Interaktion bestens betreut fühlen. Durch unseren Service und unsere Technologie streben wir stetig Exzellenz an. Einfach gesagt: Du bist stolz darauf, unsere Kunden glücklich zu machen – mit leckerem Essen am Arbeitsplatz!

## DEINE VERANTWORTUNGEN

• Kundensupport: Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kunden, bearbeitest eingehende E-Mails, Feedback und Anrufe professionell und effizient. Dabei lebst Du unser Motto: „Es gibt immer eine Lösung, niemals ein Problem.“

• Ticket-Management: Lerne, Kundenanfragen strukturiert zu bearbeiten und zu lösen. Mit proaktiven Lösungen trägst Du zur nachhaltigen Qualitätssteigerung bei.

• Prozessoptimierung: Hilf aktiv dabei, unsere Kundenservice-Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern und FELFEL auf das nächste Serviceniveau zu heben.

• Wissensaustausch & Teamzusammenarbeit: Tausche Dich mit Teammitgliedern aus und sorge für einen konsistenten, hochwertigen Kundenservice durch den Austausch von Know-how und Best Practices.

• Cross-Team-Insights: Gewinne Einblicke in verschiedene FELFEL-Bereiche (z. B. Hardware, Operations, Quality Control) und erweitere Dein Verständnis für unsere Abläufe.

## WAS DU MITBRINGST

• Ausbildung oder praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Kundendienst, Kommunikation, Hospitality, Tourismus oder einer vergleichbaren Richtung

• Du liebst es, Probleme zu lösen und Menschen zu begeistern.

• Du hast Leidenschaft für gutes Essen und die Fähigkeit, andere dafür zu begeistern.

• Du bist motiviert zu lernen, zu wachsen und versteckte Talente zu entdecken.

• Du bist begeistert von gutem Essen und sprichst leidenschaftlich über unser Angebot!

• Fliessende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind willkommen).

• Nichtraucher: FELFEL ist ein raucherfreies Unternehmen, das sich den ganzen Tag auf gutes Essen konzentriert!

• EU/EFTA oder Schweizer Arbeitsbewilligung erforderlich.

## WAS WIR BIETEN

• Jede Menge leckeres Essen, nur wenige Schritte von deinem Schreibtisch entfernt - wir erfüllen all deine kulinarischen Wünsche...

• Bester Barista-Kaffee und Tee für das ganze Team dank unserer innovativen Gavetti Kaffeemaschine

• 5 Wochen Urlaub pro Jahr

• Pro Jahr gewähren wir zwei ganze Wochen "Work from anywhere" und sorgen damit für Abwechslung im Arbeitsalltag

• Wir finanzieren dein Halbtax-Abo, und unterstützen so unsere Mitarbeitenden bei der Nutzung des ÖV

• Frisch gebackene Eltern erhalten von uns 16 bzw. 3 Wochen voll bezahlte Elternzeit. Wir unterstützen zudem die Rückkehr in den Beruf, indem wir einen grosszügigen finanziellen Beitrag an die Kinderbetreuung bis zum Erreichen des Kindergartenalters leisten

• Tolle Team-Events, wie z.B. unsere bekannten FELFEL Summer-Outings

Wenn das der richtige Job für dich ist, dann BEWIRB DICH JETZT, wir freuen uns auf dich!

Siete la persona di contatto più importante per i nostri clienti e assicuratevi che si sentano ben curati durante ogni interazione. Attraverso il nostro servizio e la tecnologia, ci sforziamo costantemente per l'eccellenza. Semplicemente messo: Sei orgoglioso di rendere felici i nostri clienti – con cibo delizioso sul posto di lavoro! ## Le tue responsabilità

• Gestione biglietti: Imparare a elaborare e risolvere le richieste dei clienti in modo strutturato. Con soluzioni proattive, contribuisci ad un aumento sostenibile della qualità.

NICE TO MEET YOU!

IN SHORT
 Customer satisfaction is at the heart of everything we do, and we are looking for someone who takes pride in making people happy with delicious food at the workplace. As our new Customer Service Agent (hourly contract at min. 24h/week) in Lausanne, you will be the main point of contact for our customers and ensure they feel well taken care of in every interaction. Step into a dynamic, hybrid role where our service and technology continuously strive for excellence!

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• You are the first point of contact for our customers, handling incoming emails, feedback, and calls professionally and efficiently. You live by our motto: “There is always a solution, never a problem.”

• Process and resolve customer inquiries in a structured way to ensure proactive, long-term quality improvement.

• Improve our customer service processes continuously to help take FELFEL to the next level of service.

• Exchange ideas with team members and share know-how to maintain consistent, high-quality customer support.

• Collaborate across different FELFEL departments, such as Hardware, Operations, and Quality Control, to broaden your understanding of our processes.

WHAT TO EXPECT

YOUR PROFILE

• Education or practical experience in business administration, communication, hospitality, tourism, or a similar field.

• Strong problem-solving skills with a genuine drive to delight people and provide excellent service.

• High motivation to learn, grow, and take on responsibility from day one.

• Passion for good food and the ability to speak enthusiastically about our culinary offerings to inspire others.

• Fluent French and English skills; German is a strong plus.

• Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

• Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

YOU WILL BE MEASURED BY

OUR BENEFITS

• Hourly rate of CHF 25.00 with regular working shifts.

• Enjoy fresh, high-quality meals just steps away from your workspace, every day.

• Fuel your day with unlimited barista-style coffee and premium tea, thanks to our Gavetti machine.

• Internal Customer Excellence training and valuable insights into Operations, Customer Excellence, and Sustainability.

• Responsibility from day one with a high level of independence.

• Work in a collaborative environment that values initiative and gives you the space to contribute your ideas.

Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either French or English.

APPLY NOW

ABOUT US

FELFEL VALUES

As a Commercial Coordinator, you ensure that everything runs smoothly in the background – from delicious customer events to smooth communication and a strong first impression. • Assessment of the potential of leads and targeted forwarding to the right teams.
• Personal delivery of goodie bags to potential customers in cooperation with the Acquisition Manager.
• Processing of customer requests such as badge creation, sending vouchers & prepaid cards and replacing badges.

• We finance your half-tax subscription and thus support our employees in the use of public transport
• Freshly baked parents receive 16 or more from us. 3 weeks of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by providing a generous financial
• Contribute to childcare until kindergarten age
• Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outings If this is the right job for you, apply now, we look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
NICE TO MEET YOU!

IN SHORT
 Are you a proactive relationship builder who thrives in a dynamic environment? As our Business Development Manager (80 - 100%) in Zurich, you will be at the heart of our customer journey. You will take full ownership of a diverse portfolio, driving client satisfaction, growth, and retention.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own and manage a large portfolio of clients from post trial engagement to renewal.

• Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key contacts to manage expectations and overall satisfaction and retention.

• Analyze client needs continuously to optimize their experience and pinpoint cross-sell or upsell opportunities.

• Drive organic growth actively within your segment to maximize account potential and business value.

• Engage proactively with clients flagged during health checks and monitor key metrics to prevent churn proactively.

• Contract negotiations, account reviews, and renewal or termination processes.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with our Acquisition, Product, Operations, and Support teams to ensure a consistent client experience.

• Provide valuable feedback to internal teams based on client insights to continuously improve our offerings and processes.

WHAT TO EXPECT

YOUR PROFILE

• 2+ years of professional experience in client success, account management, or a similar customer-facing role.

• Proven track record of efficiently managing and growing a large, diverse client portfolio.

• Confident use of CRM tools is necessary

• Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a sense of hospitality

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to connect effectively with various stakeholders.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while building meaningful, value-driven relationships.

• Fluency in German and English

• Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

• Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

YOU WILL BE MEASURED BY

• Net Revenue Retention (NRR)

• Churn Rate

• Portfolio Growth (Cross-sell/Upsell)

• Client Health Score

• Customer Satisfaction (CSAT or NPS)

OUR BENEFITS

• Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true

• Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine

• 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation

• Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day

• We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund

• New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.

• We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard

• Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing

• Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions

If this sounds like the perfect role for you, please submit your CV & complete documents (references, diplomas) in German or English!

APPLY NOW

ABOUT US

FELFEL VALUES

jobs.description:
## IN KÜRZE

Als unser Account Executive (80-100%) in Zürich stehst du im Mittelpunkt unserer Customer Journey. Du übernimmst die volle Verantwortung für ein vielfältiges Portfolio und förderst Kundenzufriedenheit, Wachstum und Kundenbindung.

## DEINE VERANTWORTUNGEN

• Eigenverantwortliche Verwaltung und Betreuung eines grossen Kundenportfolios, von der Phase nach der Testlaufzeit bis hin zur Vertragsverlängerung.

• Aufbau und Pflege starker, langfristiger Beziehungen zu wichtigen Ansprechpartnern, um Erwartungen, allgemeine Zufriedenheit und Kundenbindung zu managen.

• Kontinuierliche Analyse der Kundenbedürfnisse, um deren Erlebnis zu optimieren und Cross-Selling- oder Upselling-Möglichkeiten zu identifizieren.

• Aktive Förderung des organischen Wachstums in deinem Segment, um das Account-Potenzial und den Geschäftswert zu maximieren.

• Proaktiver Austausch mit Kunden, die bei Health Checks auffallen, sowie Überwachung wichtiger Kennzahlen, um Abwanderung (Churn) proaktiv zu verhindern.

• Vertragsverhandlungen, Account-Reviews sowie Prozesse zur Vertragsverlängerung oder -kündigung.

• Funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Teams für Akquisition, Produkt, Operations und Support, um ein einheitliches Kundenerlebnis sicherzustellen.

• Weitergabe von wertvollem Feedback auf Basis von Kundenerkenntnissen an interne Teams, um unsere Angebote und Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

## WAS DU MITBRINGST

• 2+ Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Client Success, Account Management oder in einer ähnlichen Position mit Kundenkontakt.

• Nachweisliche Erfolge im effizienten Management und Ausbau eines grossen, vielfältigen Kundenportfolios.

• Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Tools ist Voraussetzung.

• Proaktive, lösungsorientierte Denkweise mit einem Sinn für Gastfreundschaft.

• Hervorragende zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten, um effektiv mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern zu interagieren.

• Die Fähigkeit, in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig bedeutungsvolle, wertschöpfende Beziehungen aufzubauen.

• Fliessende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

• Nichtraucher/in – wir möchten nicht, dass du nach Zigaretten riechst, weder bei der Arbeit noch bei Kundenmeetings. Bei FELFEL dreht sich schliesslich alles um gutes Essen.

• Gültige Arbeitsbewilligung oder Schweizer Pass.

## WAS WIR BIETEN

• Jede Menge leckeres Essen, nur wenige Schritte von deinem Schreibtisch entfernt - wir erfüllen all deine kulinarischen Wünsche...

• Bester Barista-Kaffee und Tee für das ganze Team dank unserer innovativen Gavetti Kaffeemaschine

• 5 Wochen Urlaub pro Jahr, und die Möglichkeit, eine extra Woche zu erwerben

• Pro Jahr gewähren wir zwei ganze Wochen "Work from anywhere" und sorgen damit für Abwechslung im Arbeitsalltag

• Wir denken an deine Zukunft und bieten eine überobligatorische Pensionskassenlösung

• Frisch gebackene Eltern erhalten von uns 16 bzw. 3 Wochen voll bezahlte Elternzeit. Wir unterstützen zudem die Rückkehr in den Beruf, indem wir einen grosszügigen finanziellen Beitrag an die Kinderbetreuung bis zum Erreichen des Kindergartenalters leisten

• Wir finanzieren dein Halbtax-Abo, und unterstützen so unsere Mitarbeitenden bei der Nutzung des ÖV

• Tolle Team-Events, wie z.B. unsere bekannten FELFEL Summer-Outings

• Bleib in Bewegung und gesund mit unseren wöchentlichen Sportkursen

Klingt das nach dem perfekten Job für dich? Wir können es kaum erwarten, mehr über dich zu erfahren! BEWIRB DICH JETZT mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen auf Deutsch oder Englisch.

## IN BREAKDOW Come amministratore delegato del nostro account (80-100%) a Zurigo, sei al centro del nostro viaggio clienti. Si assume la piena responsabilità per un portafoglio diversificato e promuovere la soddisfazione del cliente, la crescita e la fedeltà. ## Le tue responsabilità
• Gestione auto-responsabile e supporto di un grande portafoglio clienti, dalla fase dopo il periodo di prova all'estensione del contratto.
• Costruire e mantenere relazioni forti e a lungo termine con i contatti chiave per gestire le aspettative, la soddisfazione generale e la fedeltà dei clienti.
• Analisi continua delle esigenze del cliente per ottimizzare la loro esperienza e identificare opportunità di cross-selling o upselling.
• Promuovi attivamente la crescita organica nel tuo segmento per massimizzare il potenziale di account e il valore aziendale.
• Scambio attivo con i clienti che si distinguono durante i controlli sanitari, nonché monitoraggio degli indicatori chiave per prevenire proattivamente la migrazione (churn).
• I negoziati contrattuali, le recensioni dei conti e i processi di estensione del contratto o di terminazione.
• Collaborazione interfunzionale con i nostri team di acquisizione, prodotto, operazioni e supporto per garantire un'esperienza clienti unificata.
• Condividere preziosi feedback basati sulle informazioni dei clienti con i team interni per migliorare continuamente le nostre offerte e processi. ## Cosa porti
• 2+ anni di esperienza professionale nel successo del cliente, nella gestione del conto o in una posizione simile con il contatto del cliente.
• Dimostrabile successo nella gestione efficiente e nell'espansione di un ampio e diversificato portafoglio clienti.
• L'uso sicuro degli strumenti CRM è un prerequisito.
• Mindset proattivo e orientato alla soluzione con un senso di ospitalità.
• Eccellente capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione per interagire efficacemente con diversi stakeholder.
• La capacità di lavorare in un ambiente veloce durante la costruzione di relazioni significative e di valore.
• Conoscenza fluida del tedesco e dell'inglese.
• Non fumatori – non vogliamo che sentiate odore di sigarette, né al lavoro né alle riunioni dei clienti. Dopo tutto, FELFEL è tutto circa il buon cibo.
• Permesso di lavoro valido o passaporto svizzero. ## Cosa offriamo
• Un sacco di cibo delizioso, a pochi passi dalla vostra scrivania - soddisfiamo tutti i vostri desideri culinari...
• Migliore caffè barista e tè per tutta la squadra grazie alla nostra innovativa macchina da caffè Gavetti
• 5 settimane di vacanza all'anno, e la possibilità di acquistare una settimana extra
• Ogni anno concediamo due settimane intere "lavoro da qualsiasi luogo" e quindi forniamo varietà nel lavoro quotidiano
• Pensiamo al tuo futuro e offriamo una soluzione di fondo pensione supercompulsori
• I genitori appena cotti ricevono 16 o più da noi. 3 settimane di congedo parentale completamente pagato. Sosteniamo anche il ritorno al lavoro fornendo un generoso contributo finanziario all'infanzia fino all'età dell'asilo.
• Finanziamo l'abbonamento a mezza quota e quindi sosteniamo i nostri dipendenti nell'uso dei trasporti pubblici
• Grandi eventi di squadra, come il nostro noto FELFEL Summer Outings
• Rimanere in movimento e sano con i nostri corsi sportivi settimanali Ti sembra il lavoro perfetto? Non vediamo l’ora di saperne di più su di te! EMPLOY NOW con i vostri documenti completi in tedesco o in inglese.
